meta_description:
175 likes, 21 comments - cookieandkate on October 24, 2026: "This week’s meal plan includes fall favorites! I like to rotate in easy staples like baked potatoes and vegetarian chili with favorites like these cauliflower lentil tacos and hearty sweet potato salad. And if you’re looking for a Friday “pizza” night the spaghetti squash bowls are perfect. ⁠
⁠
Featured recipes include: ⁠
⁠
Best Vegetarian Chili⁠
Roasted Cauliflower Lentil Tacos with Chipotle Sauce⁠
Perfect Baked Potatoes⁠
Hearty Sweet Potato, Arugula & Wild Rice Salad with Ginger Dressing⁠
Spaghetti Squash “Pizza” Bowls ⁠
⁠
Plus you’ll find tips for easy meal prep, and suggestions for sides, breakfasts, and snacks for the week. ⁠
⁠
Find the full meal plan, plus suggested breakfast and snack ideas in the email newsletter or comment “save” and I’ll send you a link. You can also find the recipes in the new meal plan section of the blog @CookieandKate and sign up to receive the newsletter at the link in bio! ⁠
⁠
https://us8.campaign-archive.com/?u=ef84c57f094f5006504d082b6&id=85e6ba67a6".
